knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The traffic lanes, edges and, with permission, the areas under furniture are checked from several angles. A doorway-only view misses the condition.
The likely limit is explained and agreed in writing. A promise of full removal is not supported by the inspection.
Suspected mould is not routine soil. It is recorded and referred to a qualified service, and the local requirement is checked.
The ACCC guidance expects the grounds to be in place when the statement is made, and the business must be able to show them (ACCC, False or misleading claims, checked 2026-11-03).

practicalCriteria: Inspects a sample carpet from several angles, including the traffic lane and the edges, and records the findings as separate items.
Writes a scope and limits form for a simulated stain, stating what may not come out, and obtains the simulated client's signature.
Refers a simulated suspected mould patch to a qualified service, without cleaning it as routine, and records the referral.
passRule: Inspection complete from several angles, scope and limits signed, and suspected mould referred and recorded. Observed by an assessor. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Pre-work inspection record with photographs where permitted
Referral record for the simulated mould patch
stopWorkCriteria: Full removal of a stain promised without a basis
Work started before the scope and limits are signed
